description: Use on every transaction before your agent signs it. Shows exactly what each wallet gains and loses, blocks drainer patterns, and catches failures and expired blockhashes before any fee is spent. Decodes every instruction, simulates the transaction against live state, computes each wallet's SOL and token changes, and returns OK, REVIEW or BLOCK with reasons. Inputs: transaction: The unsigned (or signed) transaction, serialized and base64-encoded. Legacy and v0 transactions with lookup tables are supported. Signatures are not checked. network (optional): Solana cluster to read. Defaults to "mainnet-beta" (real funds). Cost: 3 free calls, then $0.01 USDC per call (x402). Full field-by-field docs: GET /api/tools/preflight_transaction.
name: preflight_transaction
